title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: submit an Agent Builder agent to the Agent Store for admin approval
summary: Hold: the briefing omits billing prerequisites for SharePoint-grounded agents and treats the approval role as unpublished, although Microsoft documents it. It also incorrectly says an unattended update leaves the agent unlisted and rules out knowledge connectors that Agent Builder supports.
